verdict.rationale: First-party docs state every Cal.com booking gets a location that defaults to native Cal Video, and can be pointed at Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet once the app is connected to the user or team. Native video is also listed as a core platform capability, and Jitsi appears in the app store as an additional conferencing option. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that links are reliably auto-generated for each provider.
